# Turn an RFP into a compliance matrix

> Paste an RFP, RFQ or tender. Get a compliance matrix of every shall/must/required obligation with section numbers, categories and owner/status columns, plus the page limits, due dates and forms. CSV download. Private, in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
